source_event_id: routine-paused-<uid>-<routine_id>-<stream id of the third refused run> — keyed to the PAUSE: a redelivery dedupes, and a routine switched back on and paused again is a second occurrence and a second card
description: A scheduled routine was switched off because its runs kept being refused the same way: agent-api reads each run's outcome off the worker's output stream (`done.refused`) before the next fire and, at three consecutive refusals with one reason, writes `enabled: false` and a `paused_reason:` line into `routines/<name>.md`, cancels its job and publishes this; triggers `routine_paused`, whose step re-reads the routine file and blocks while it stays off, which is the person's one queue card. `routine` is the file's name, `reason` the refusal reason (usually `human_session_required`). Re-derivable from the desk like `desk.unscaffolded`: a publish that never lands loses the card, never the fact. Absent from the no-agents profile because the agent domain is. NOT PUBLISHED FROM THIS TREE (`published_by: private`), on the same terms as claim.proposed: the publisher lives in the agent-api control plane.
